response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Developer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and systems programming, but he is drastically overqualified for this entry-level/junior-mid fullstack role. His seniority, compensation expectations, and career trajectory mismatch the position, and there's no direct evidence of React, Nest.js, or PostgreSQL experience — his stack leans MongoDB, DLang, and diverse languages rather than the specified requirements.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across TypeScript/Node.js and many other languages
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing) and mentoring/teaching experience
Proven ability to work across the entire stack from database to UI, plus AWS/Kubernetes exposure via GISCollective
concerns: Significantly overqualified (Staff/Senior level) for a junior/mid entry-level position, likely mismatched compensation and growth expectations
No explicit React or Nest.js experience listed; primary web frameworks are Ember.js, and DB experience skews MongoDB/MySQL rather than PostgreSQL
No mention of energy/construction industry domain or CRM/document management integration experience relevant to this specific product
